provenance.title: Degeneration of hyperbolic structures on the figure-eight knot complement and points of finite order on an elliptic curve

candidates.statement: Let K be the ﬁgure-eight knot in the 3-dimensional sphere S3. Also, let C : z(z −1)w(w −1) = 1 be the deformation curve of hyperbolic structures on the ﬁgure-eight knot com- plement S3 −K. For each coprime pair of integers (p, q), let us denote by (S3 −K)(p,q) a closed 3-manifold obtained from S3 −K by a Dehn ﬁlling along K that kills the homotopy class of the simple closed curve pm + ql, where m and l are the standard meridian and longitude of K in S3.
